svg.text: Pump sensing — low-side shunts, Kelvin pairs to three INA226s
Every pump on the always-on bus. The negative lead carries every operating mode, so one shunt per pump sees them all.
publishes volts and amps to Signal K
Sense leads on the negative side need no fuse.
A tripped breaker reads as zero volts on that pump's VBUS — an alarm.
P1 and P2 current never crosses the board; P3's already does, through Q8.
10 kΩ series resistor is a stand-in.
